description: This file is a PHP source file implementing a Smarty plugin function for generating HTML <select> elements with <option> tags. It defines the main function 'smarty_function_html_options' for creating the options list and supporting functions for handling option output, groups, and escaping special characters.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_options
methods.description: Generates an HTML <select> element with options based on provided parameters. Handles options, values, selected items, and additional attributes.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_options_optoutput
methods.description: Creates an individual <option> tag or an option group within a select, handling selected state and escaping.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_options_optgroup
methods.description: Generates an <optgroup> element containing nested options.
